name: 一日一笺 · 可爱电子手账 · Android UI/VI
status: proposed design direction; not user-approved; not implemented

platform.delivery: UI/VI design only; not an APK or running component

units.artboard: proposed 412 dp reference; not a device measurement

colorSemantics.bodyText: ink; opaque and stable while reading or editing
colorSemantics.unselectedNavigation: ink; do not use faint accent text
colorSemantics.photoAndCloudMaterial: powderBlueAccent; illustration or decorative material only; not a cloud-backup claim
colorSemantics.plantMaterial: sageAccent; illustration and sticker material only
colorSemantics.error: ink wording plus visible icon; do not communicate failure by accent color alone
colorSemantics.boundaries: ink with restrained opacity for decorative lines; necessary input/focus boundaries remain visible

type.family: Android CJK sans; final native font asset not selected
type.brand: proposed rounded Chinese sans wordmark; no font binary included
type.fontScale: respect system fontScale; future review at 2.0; not yet verified

touch.minimumMeaning: actual non-overlapping proposed target; glyph size is not target size

systemInsets.ime: real system keyboard; never draw keyboard as an app-owned input

editor.structure: proposed native full-screen journal editing; no desktop side panel
editor.keyboard: real Android system IME; toolbar sits above IME when open and above gesture inset when closed
editor.contentInitialState: empty; no fabricated default records, photos, tasks or applied stickers
editor.photos: actual user-selected media; design examples and placeholders are not inserted content
editor.stickers: insert only after an explicit user selection; supporting decorative materials are not presumed page data

brand.name: 小笺
brand.smallSizeRule: keep silhouette, fold and face; no tiny added accessories
brand.status: original proposed mascot design; not approved by user; not a rendered app icon package

depth.scope: 3D texture is restricted to materials, stickers and small empty-state illustration
uses: flower, cup, leaf and cloud sticker materials
depth.emptyStateRule: illustration communicates an empty page; it is not an inserted journal item and is not saved as user content
depth.materialDirection: soft stylized volume; no photoreal notebook or tabletop scene; consistent gentle light
depth.performance: implementation and device performance not evaluated

motion.reducedMotion: static material imagery; keep input and navigation semantics intact

designEvidence.referenceStatus: AI-generated concept board; not a runtime screenshot or user content
designEvidence.svgStatus: deterministic editable flat source; no embedded raster, font binaries or JavaScript
designEvidence.runtimeChecks: none; no Android device, emulator, accessibility or performance claim
